notes.subject: אפי
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok "nais bilong mi i buruk" bilong tok bel i hat; Tok Pisin "bel bilong mi i pulap long paia".

notes.subject: מדה כנגד מדה
notes.rationale: Ol i pulapenim ol widow na orphan, olsem na ol meri bilong ol na ol pikinini bilong ol bai i kamap olsem — pasin i kamap olsem wanem ol i wokim.

translation: Bel bilong mi bai i pulap long paia, na mi bai kilim ⟨את⟩ yupela long bainat; na ol meri bilong yupela bai i kamap meri bilong man i dai pinis, na ol pikinini bilong yupela bai i kamap pikinini bilong papa i dai pinis.

tokens.gloss: meri bilong man i dai pinis
pikinini bilong papa i dai pinis
